attacked_claim.text: That the module's live-consumed KPI surfaces (pinned_verified_pass_count_13_rate=PASSED, arithmetic_subset_6_of_6_pass_rate=PASSED, capability-profile n_pass=6/6) are CURRENT with respect to the module's own prior signed falsification findings.

does_not_close: Does not re-argue whether the underlying density arithmetic (8.22, 10.24 lb/gal) is physically correct -- that is the prior receipt's concern.
Does not modify docs/mission.md, docs/capability-profile.json, RETRACTION-INDEX.md, control_by_control_receipt.v1.json, or any signed Phase-0 KPI; flags them for human/repair-fire correction only.
Does not establish a specific SLA for how quickly a REFUTED finding must propagate; treats >24h with zero movement on any surface as sufficient to call the currency claim false for this fire.

falsification_criterion.refuted_if: the already-signed 2026-08-16 f160-density-source-conflict-credit-violation-v1 REFUTED finding is not propagated into ANY live consumer surface (mission.md prose+KPI, capability-profile.json, RETRACTION-INDEX.md, arithmetic_audit.json), AND every hash-pinned source file the prior receipt cited is BYTE-IDENTICAL to its state at the prior attack time (proving zero repair action was taken, not merely a documentation lag)
falsification_criterion.survives_if: at least one consumer surface carries a caveat/correction pointing to the prior finding, OR a RETRACTION-INDEX entry exists for it, OR any of the hash-pinned source files has changed since the prior attack time

independent_rederivation_from_scratch.method: Parsed known_reference_cards.json red_team_self_audit + F160-BLACK card source_conflict block directly (not the prior receipt's prose); cross-referenced arithmetic_audit.json row URLs against the F160-BLACK card's source_urls; flagged any non-F160-BLACK control sharing that URL with VERIFIED_PASS status and no source_conflict field of its own.
